'''''Metric Structures for Riemannian and Non-Riemannian Spaces''''' is a book in [[geometry]] by [[Mikhail Leonidovich Gromov|Mikhail Gromov]]. It was originally published in French in 1981 under the title '''''Structures métriques pour les variétés riemanniennes''''', by CEDIC (Paris). 

==History==
The 1981 edition was edited by [[Jacques Lafontaine]] and [[Pierre Pansu]]. The English version, considerably expanded, was published in 1999 by [[Birkhäuser Verlag]], with appendices by Pierre Pansu, [[Stephen Semmes]], and [[Mikhail Katz]]. The book was well received<ref>[https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=1699320 Review] by Igor Belegradek (''[[MathSciNet]]'')</ref><ref>[http://www.zentralblatt-math.org/zmath/en/advanced/?q=an:0953.53002&format=complete Review] by Mircea Craioveanu (''[[Zentralblatt Math]]'')</ref> and has been reprinted several times.
